'''Marna''' was the daughter of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] [[Defaris Muslo]], and a operative for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. She was captured and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an Imperial [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]]; her father did not know of her allegiance, and blamed the Alliance for her death.
